 Medicare Open Enrollment Tip: Assistance is Free
 October 29, 2026 
 As a reminder, the Annual Enrollment Period (AEP) (also called “Open Enrollment”) is the time between October 15 through December 7 when a Medicare beneficiary can change from one Part D plan to another, change from a Medicare Advantage plan to Traditional Medicare (and enroll in a Part D plan), enroll in a Medicare Advantage plan, and change from one Medicare Advantage plan to another. Enrollment is effective the first day of the next calendar year (January 1, 2027).
 There are many free, unbiased resources that provide assistance comparing options and enrolling, including:
 Medicare.gov Planfinder Tool The Medicare.gov Planfinder tool is a federal government website managed and paid for by the U.S. Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS). Here , you can get a summary of your current coverage as well as compare plan costs for the following year.
 1-800-MEDICARE For questions beyond what is available on Medicare.gov, you can call 1-800-MEDICARE 24 hours a day, 7 days a week (with the exception of some federal holidays). Live chat is also available here .
 SHIP Counselors State Health Insurance Assistance Program (SHIP) counselors provide local, in-depth, and unbiased insurance counseling and assistance to Medicare-eligible individuals, their families, and caregivers. There is no charge to consumer for this assistance. To find a counselor in your area, visit here and click “Find Local Medicare Help.”
 Area Agencies on Aging (AAAs) An Area Agency on Aging (AAA) is a public or private nonprofit agency designated by a state to address the needs and concerns of older persons at the regional and local levels. You can find your local AAA by visiting the Eldercare Locator website or calling 1-800-677-1116.
 A key point to remember that even though this assistance is free, appointment access is limited. It is important to contact these resources well before the December 7, 2026 deadline.
 October 22, 2026 – C. Huberty
